notes: UK-level, not Welsh. Tagged medium confidence on the read-across: the CCC response does not mention the devolved administrations.
summary: Parliament passed the Seventh Carbon Budget into law on or before 24 June 2026, setting a legally binding reduction of about 87 percent for 2038 to 2042. The CCC welcomed it and pressed for electrification at pace. This is the UK-level trajectory that sits above Wales' own carbon budgets, so it shapes the ambition context for SI6 even though Welsh budgets are set separately.
title: UK Seventh Carbon Budget passes into law: about 87 percent reduction for 2038 to 2042
